name: I Died & Reincarnated as an Evil Spirit!
source:
You wake up in a fortune teller's tent, reborn as an evil spirit. Exorcists are on their way to banish you to the afterlife, but there’s one way out: charm the exorcist. 

That’s right – if you can make this exorcist fall in love with you, there may be a chance at redemption.

[From [url=https://byenmelon.itch.io/i-died-reincarnated-as-an-evil-spirit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在算命师的帐篷里醒来，重生为恶灵。驱魔师正准备将你驱逐到来世，但有一个出路：迷住驱魔师。

没错，如果你能让这位驱魔师爱上你，或许还有救赎的机会。

[来自[url=https://byenmelon.itch.io/i-died-reincarnated-as-an-evil-spirit]Itch.io[/url]]
